verdicts.reason: A reads left to right with a large serif headline and a clear CTA at top right. Its flaws: the fine print is oversized and wraps in a ragged 3-line block, sitting over the bokeh dots beside the CTA; the logo and can are tiny; and the angled sale ribbon is jammed into the bottom-left corner. B shrinks the headline to fine-print size, so it is barely bigger than the legal line beneath it. The can is a speck, the CTA is a small, hard-to-read pill, the ribbon floats isolated, and large empty areas leave no clear focal point.
